title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 250 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 250 - Appeal In case of disallowance of foreign tax rebate claimed by a payer, in whole or in part, by an order passed by the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes, the payer may appeal to the Appellate Joint Commissioner within 30 (thirty) days of the order passed by the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes within 30 days of reaching the payer and likewise the provisions of Chapter II of Part 20 shall apply with necessary amendments. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
